youtube_short.description: When you switched jobs, did you actually bring your 401k with you? Most people don't — and there's $1.65 trillion sitting in abandoned accounts right now. Old orphaned 401ks trap former employees in high-fee funds, costing up to 0.8% more per year. On $150,000 over 20 years, that compounds into $116,000 gone — just in extra fees. The fix takes 15 minutes: open an IRA, request a direct rollover, pay zero taxes and zero penalties. Don't leave six figures sitting at your old job. #401k #personalfinance #investing #retirementplanning #moneytips
